description: This file is a JUnit test class for testing the MessageMappingProcessorActor in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging package. It specifically tests header interactions, especially around acknowledgements, response requirements, and timeouts during message processing.

classes.name: MessageMappingProcessorActorHeaderInteractionTest
classes.description: A JUnit parameterized test class that tests header interactions within MessageMappingProcessorActor, focusing on acknowledgement handling, response requirements, and timeouts.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the main test logic for different parameter combinations, sending messages to ActorRefs, simulating responses, and verifying publisher behavior based on the message headers and simulated outcomes.

methods.name: getModifyThing
methods.description: Creates a ModifyThing object with specific headers configured for the test case, including timeout, responseRequired flag, and acknowledgement requests.

methods.name: getModifyThingResponse
methods.description: Generates a response object, either a successful ModifyThingResponse or an exception, based on the test scenario's success flag.

methods.name: getExpectedOutcome
methods.description: Determines the expected HTTP status code for the test case based on timeout, response requirement, acknowledgement requests, and success flags.
